message.reasoning:
need to process the single order and statement.

Order PED-1006 amount 100.00, expires at 10:00 -03:00.

Statement line: payment, amount 99.99, time 11:00 -03:00, txid matches order id. So linked.

Compute status:

First, check if payment linked: yes.

Now compute total amount received from distinct transfers: only one e2e_id, amount 99.99.

Compare to order amount 100.00: less than, so underpaid.

But also need to consider time: payment at 11:00 which is after expires_at (10:00). However rule order priority: unpaid, refunded, underpaid, overpaid, late_paid, paid. So underpaid applies before late_paid. So status = "underpaid".

Payments list: includes e2e_id "E1000000010001". No refunds.

Orphans: any payment lines not linked to any order. This line is linked, so none. Orphans = [].

Return JSON.

Make sure amounts are numeric? In schema they are strings for status and list of strings. So use order id as key.

Thus:

{
 "orders": {
   "PED-1006": {
     "status": "underpaid",
     "payments": ["E1000000010001"]
   }
 },
 "orphans": []
}

Wrap in markdown json code block.
